```{r}
# 1. Load packages
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(geometry)  
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(Maaslin2)
library(readr)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```


```{r}
# 2. Import count and metadata (fixed version)
otu_file  <- "taxatable-filtered-absolute_w_taxonomy.txt" 

# Input taxonomy/count table containing raw (unnormalized) microbial counts.
# The original input filename is retained here for reproducibility.

#Sample metadata
meta_file <- "metadata.tsv"

# Read file — note: taxonomy is the first column
taxatable <- read.table(
  otu_file,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

head(colnames(taxatable))

#  Remove the "OTU ID" column (second column)
taxatable <- taxatable[, -1]

#  Extract counts and taxonomy
otu_counts <- taxatable[, sapply(taxatable, is.numeric)]  # Counts only
taxonomy_strings <- rownames(taxatable)         # Taxonomy strings are rownames

#  Split taxonomy into hierarchical levels
tax_split <- data.frame(do.call(rbind, strsplit(taxonomy_strings, ";\\s*")))
colnames(tax_split) <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species","Strain")[1:ncol(tax_split)]
rownames(tax_split) <- rownames(otu_counts)

#  Read metadata and align
meta <- read.table(
  meta_file,
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)
head(meta)

# Align OTU table and metadata
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(otu_counts), rownames(meta))

otu_counts <- otu_counts[, common_samples]
meta <- meta[common_samples, ]

# Recode treatment groups
meta$SampleType <- recode(
  meta$SampleType,
  "Control" = "CON",
  "PAE"     = "ALC",
  "CBD"     = "CB",
  "SAC"     = "ALC+CB"
)

# Set desired order
meta$SampleType <- factor(
  meta$SampleType,
  levels = c("CON", "ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)


```
###Phyloseq object
```{r}
# 3. Build phyloseq object
ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu_counts), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(tax_split)),
  sample_data(meta)
)

# Quick check
ps

# Integrity check
cat("Number of taxa:", ntaxa(ps), "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", nsamples(ps), "\n\n")

# Sample names that do not match
setdiff(sample_names(ps), rownames(sample_data(ps)))

# Confirm sample sums
summary(sample_sums(ps))

# Confirm OTU table and metadata sample alignment
identical(sort(sample_names(ps)), sort(rownames(sample_data(ps))))
```
#######Maaslin2_Genus############ Used raw counts file
```{r}
# 4. QC sample exclusion and Differential Abundance Maaslin2 (Genus) — SEQ13 removed
# Exclude MICE.SEQ13 based on sequencing QC because of
# extreme sequencing depth/library-size imbalance.

# ============================================
#  Remove SEQ13
# ============================================
ps_no13 <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps) != "MICE.SEQ13", ps)

cat("Original samples:", nsamples(ps), "\n")
cat("After removing SEQ13:", nsamples(ps_no13), "\n")

# ============================================
# 4.1. Agglomerate to Genus
# ============================================
ps_genus_no13 <- tax_glom(ps_no13, taxrank = "Genus")

# ============================================
# Clean genus names
# ============================================
genus_vec_no13 <- as.vector(tax_table(ps_genus_no13)[, "Genus"])
genus_vec_no13 <- gsub("^g__", "", genus_vec_no13)
genus_vec_no13[is.na(genus_vec_no13) | genus_vec_no13 == ""] <- "Unclassified"
genus_vec_no13 <- paste0("g_", genus_vec_no13)
genus_vec_no13 <- make.unique(genus_vec_no13)
taxa_names(ps_genus_no13) <- genus_vec_no13

# ============================================
# Build Feature Table (samples x genera)
# ============================================
feature_table_no13 <- as(otu_table(ps_genus_no13), "matrix")

# If taxa are rows (taxa x samples), transpose
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus_no13)) {
  feature_table_no13 <- t(feature_table_no13)
}

# Remove zero-only genera (columns)
feature_table_no13 <- feature_table_no13[, colSums(feature_table_no13) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# Force numeric
mode(feature_table_no13) <- "numeric"

# ============================================
# Build Clean Metadata (must match ps_genus_no13)
# ============================================
metadata_no13 <- data.frame(
  sampleID     = sample_names(ps_genus_no13),
  SampleType   = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_no13)$SampleType)),
  Sex          = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_no13)$Sex)),
  Dam_Identity = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_no13)$Dam_Identity))
)

# Set reference levels
metadata_no13$SampleType <- relevel(metadata_no13$SampleType, ref = "CON")
metadata_no13$Sex        <- relevel(metadata_no13$Sex, ref = "F")

# Prepare metadata for Maaslin2
metadata_for_model_no13 <- metadata_no13
rownames(metadata_for_model_no13) <- metadata_for_model_no13$sampleID
metadata_for_model_no13$sampleID <- NULL

# Reorder metadata to match feature table rows (samples) — NO13 version
metadata_for_model_no13 <- metadata_for_model_no13[
  match(rownames(feature_table_no13), rownames(metadata_for_model_no13)),
  , drop = FALSE
]

# Final alignment check — NO13 version
stopifnot(all(rownames(metadata_for_model_no13) == rownames(feature_table_no13)))


# ============================================
# Sanity Checks
# ============================================
cat("Feature table dimensions (samples x genera):\n")
print(dim(feature_table_no13))
cat("Metadata dimensions:\n")
print(dim(metadata_for_model_no13))

cat("SampleType distribution:\n")
print(table(metadata_for_model_no13$SampleType, useNA="ifany"))
cat("Sex distribution:\n")
print(table(metadata_for_model_no13$Sex, useNA="ifany"))

# Confirm SEQ13 is truly gone
stopifnot(!("MICE.SEQ13" %in% rownames(feature_table_no13)))
stopifnot(!("MICE.SEQ13" %in% rownames(metadata_for_model_no13)))


# Main output folder
outdir <- file.path("Maaslin2_output_no13", "Genus")

if (dir.exists(outdir)) {
  unlink(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
}
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

table(metadata_for_model_no13$SampleType)
# ============================================
# Run Maaslin2
# ============================================
fit <- Maaslin2(
  input_data       = feature_table_no13,
  input_metadata   = metadata_for_model_no13,
  output           = outdir,
  fixed_effects    = c("SampleType", "Sex"),
  random_effects   = c("Dam_Identity"),
  reference        = c("SampleType,CON", "Sex,F"),
  normalization    = "TSS",
  transform        = "LOG",
  analysis_method  = "LM",
  min_prevalence   = 0.10,
  min_abundance    = 0.0001,
  plot_heatmap     = TRUE,
  plot_scatter     = FALSE
)

# ============================================
# Load Results
# ============================================
res_no13 <- read.table(
  file.path(outdir, "all_results.tsv"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
res_sig_no13 <- subset(res_no13, qval <= 0.25)

# Quick look
head(res_no13)

# Additional diagnostics
summary(res_no13$qval)
table(res_no13$metadata)
table(res_no13$metadata, res_no13$qval <= 0.25)


# =========================
#MaAsLin2 Volcano_Genus_no13
# =========================

res_genus <- read_tsv(file.path(outdir, "all_results.tsv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

metadata_var <- "SampleType"
q_cut <- 0.25
label_top_n <- 17

sig_col <- if ("qval" %in% colnames(res_genus)) "qval" else "pval"

df <- res_genus %>%
  filter(metadata == metadata_var) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10 = -log10(pmax(.data[[sig_col]], 1e-300)),
    significance = case_when(
      .data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut & coef > 0  ~ "Enriched",
      .data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut & coef < 0  ~ "Depleted",
      TRUE                                  ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

# Set facet order
df$value <- factor(
  df$value,
  levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)

# Top taxa per contrast
label_df <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut) %>%
  group_by(value) %>%
  arrange(.data[[sig_col]], desc(abs(coef))) %>%
  slice_head(n = label_top_n) %>%
  ungroup()

label_df$value <- factor(
  label_df$value,
  levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)

volcano_colors <- c(
  "Enriched" = "#D73027",
  "Depleted" = "#4575B4",
  "Not Significant" = "grey75"
)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = coef, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significance), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(q_cut), linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ value, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient (log-scale effect)",
    y = paste0("-log10(", sig_col, ")"),
    title = paste0("Genus-level Differential Abundance (no SEQ13) (qval <= 0.25)")
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = feature),
    size = 3.2,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir,
    "Maaslin2_Genus_SampleType_no13_Volcano.pdf"
  ),
  p,
  width = 11,
  height = 6
)
```

### 4.4. Species_no13
```{r}
### Differential Abundance MaAsLin2 (Species) — SEQ13 removed

# ============================================
# Remove SEQ13
# ============================================
ps_no13 <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps) != "MICE.SEQ13", ps)

cat("Original samples:", nsamples(ps), "\n")
cat("After removing SEQ13:", nsamples(ps_no13), "\n")

# ============================================
# Agglomerate to Species
# ============================================
ps_species_no13 <- tax_glom(ps_no13, taxrank = "Species")

# ============================================
#  Clean species names
# ============================================
species_vec_no13 <- as.vector(tax_table(ps_species_no13)[, "Species"])
species_vec_no13 <- gsub("^s__", "", species_vec_no13)
species_vec_no13[is.na(species_vec_no13) | species_vec_no13 == ""] <- "Unclassified"
species_vec_no13 <- paste0("s_", species_vec_no13)
species_vec_no13 <- make.unique(species_vec_no13)
taxa_names(ps_species_no13) <- species_vec_no13

# ============================================
# Build Feature Table (samples x species)
# ============================================
feature_table_no13 <- as(otu_table(ps_species_no13), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_species_no13)) {
  feature_table_no13 <- t(feature_table_no13)
}

feature_table_no13 <- feature_table_no13[, colSums(feature_table_no13) > 0, drop = FALSE]
mode(feature_table_no13) <- "numeric"

# ============================================
# Build Clean Metadata
# ============================================
metadata_no13 <- data.frame(
  sampleID     = sample_names(ps_species_no13),
  SampleType   = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_species_no13)$SampleType)),
  Sex          = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_species_no13)$Sex)),
  Dam_Identity = as.factor(as.character(sample_data(ps_species_no13)$Dam_Identity))
)

metadata_no13$SampleType <- relevel(metadata_no13$SampleType, ref = "CON")
metadata_no13$Sex        <- relevel(metadata_no13$Sex, ref = "F")

metadata_for_model_no13 <- metadata_no13
rownames(metadata_for_model_no13) <- metadata_for_model_no13$sampleID
metadata_for_model_no13$sampleID <- NULL

metadata_for_model_no13 <- metadata_for_model_no13[
  match(rownames(feature_table_no13), rownames(metadata_for_model_no13)),
  , drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(all(rownames(metadata_for_model_no13) == rownames(feature_table_no13)))

# ============================================
# Sanity Checks
# ============================================
cat("Feature table dimensions (samples x species):\n")
print(dim(feature_table_no13))

cat("Metadata dimensions:\n")
print(dim(metadata_for_model_no13))

cat("SampleType distribution:\n")
print(table(metadata_for_model_no13$SampleType, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("Sex distribution:\n")
print(table(metadata_for_model_no13$Sex, useNA = "ifany"))

stopifnot(!("MICE.SEQ13" %in% rownames(feature_table_no13)))
stopifnot(!("MICE.SEQ13" %in% rownames(metadata_for_model_no13)))

# Main output folder
outdir <- file.path("Maaslin2_output_no13", "Species")

if (dir.exists(outdir)) {
  unlink(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
}
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

table(metadata_for_model_no13$SampleType)

# ============================================
# Run MaAsLin2
# ============================================
fit_species <- Maaslin2(
  input_data       = feature_table_no13,
  input_metadata   = metadata_for_model_no13,
  output           = outdir,
  fixed_effects    = c("SampleType", "Sex"),
  random_effects   = c("Dam_Identity"),
  reference        = c("SampleType,CON", "Sex,F"),
  normalization    = "TSS",
  transform        = "LOG",
  analysis_method  = "LM",
  min_prevalence   = 0.10,
  min_abundance    = 0.0001,
  plot_heatmap     = FALSE,
  plot_scatter     = FALSE
)

# ============================================
# Load Results
# ============================================
res_species_no13 <- read.table(
  file.path(outdir, "all_results.tsv"),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

res_sig_species_no13 <- subset(res_species_no13, qval <= 0.25)

head(res_species_no13)

summary(res_species_no13$qval)
table(res_species_no13$metadata)
table(res_species_no13$metadata, res_species_no13$qval <= 0.25)

# =========================
# MaAsLin2 Volcano_Species_no13
# =========================

res_species <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(outdir, "all_results.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

metadata_var <- "SampleType"
q_cut <- 0.25
label_top_n <- 20

sig_col <- if ("qval" %in% colnames(res_species)) "qval" else "pval"

df <- res_species %>%
  filter(metadata == metadata_var) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10 = -log10(pmax(.data[[sig_col]], 1e-300)),
    significance = case_when(
      .data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut & coef > 0 ~ "Enriched",
      .data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut & coef < 0 ~ "Depleted",
      TRUE                                 ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

df$value <- factor(
  df$value,
  levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)

label_df <- df %>%
  filter(.data[[sig_col]] <= q_cut) %>%
  group_by(value) %>%
  arrange(.data[[sig_col]], desc(abs(coef))) %>%
  slice_head(n = label_top_n) %>%
  ungroup()

label_df$value <- factor(
  label_df$value,
  levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)

volcano_colors <- c(
  "Enriched" = "#D73027",
  "Depleted" = "#4575B4",
  "Not Significant" = "grey75"
)

p_species <- ggplot(df, aes(x = coef, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significance), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(q_cut), linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ value, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient (log-scale effect)",
    y = paste0("-log10(", sig_col, ")"),
    title = "Species-level Differential Abundance (no SEQ13) (qval <= 0.25)"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = feature),
    size = 3.2,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )

print(p_species)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Maaslin2_Species_SampleType_no13_Volcano.pdf"),
  p_species,
  width = 11,
  height = 6
)
```

5. Combine differential abundance results
```{r}

############################################################
# Read MaAsLin2 results for each level
############################################################

base_dir <- "Maaslin2_output_no13"

res_genus   <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Genus", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_class   <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Class", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_phylum  <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Phylum", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_family  <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Family", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_species <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Species", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

############################################################
# Add taxonomic level labels
############################################################

res_genus$Level   <- "Genus"
res_family$Level  <- "Family"
res_phylum$Level  <- "Phylum"
res_class$Level   <- "Class"
res_species$Level <- "Species"

############################################################
# Combine and keep SampleType associations only
############################################################

combined <- bind_rows(
  res_genus,
  res_family,
  res_phylum,
  res_class,
  res_species
) %>%
  filter(metadata == "SampleType") %>%
  mutate(
    value = factor(value, levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")),
    Level = factor(Level, levels = c("Phylum", "Class", "Family", "Genus", "Species")),
    neglog10 = -log10(pmax(qval, 1e-300)),
    significance = case_when(
      qval <= 0.05 ~ "q<=0.05",
      qval <= 0.10 ~ "q<=0.10",
      qval <= 0.25 ~ "q<=0.25",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Level, value, qval)

############################################################
# Split by thresholds
############################################################

res_q05 <- combined %>% filter(qval <= 0.05)
res_q10 <- combined %>% filter(qval <= 0.10)
res_q25 <- combined %>% filter(qval <= 0.25)

############################################################
# Export to Excel inside main output folder
############################################################

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "All_SampleType_Associations")
writeData(wb, "All_SampleType_Associations", combined)

addWorksheet(wb, "q_less_0.05")
writeData(wb, "q_less_0.05", res_q05)

addWorksheet(wb, "q_less_0.10")
writeData(wb, "q_less_0.10", res_q10)

addWorksheet(wb, "q_less_0.25")
writeData(wb, "q_less_0.25", res_q25)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  file.path(base_dir, "Maaslin2_Combined_TaxLevels_SampleType.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Combined multi-level Excel file created successfully.\n")
```

06. Differential-abundance figures

```{r}
#### COMBINE VOLCANO PLOT for Phylum, Class, Family, Genus

base_dir <- "Maaslin2_output_no13"

# Read results
res_genus  <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Genus", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_class  <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Class", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_phylum <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Phylum", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
res_family <- read_tsv(file.path(base_dir, "Family", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Add taxonomic level column
res_genus$Level  <- "Genus"
res_class$Level  <- "Class"
res_phylum$Level <- "Phylum"
res_family$Level <- "Family"

# Combine and keep only SampleType associations
combined <- bind_rows(
  res_phylum,
  res_class,
  res_family,
  res_genus
) %>%
  filter(metadata == "SampleType") %>%
  mutate(
    value = factor(value, levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")),
    Level = factor(Level, levels = c("Phylum", "Class", "Family", "Genus"))
  )

# Define significance threshold
q_cut <- 0.25

# Keep significant only
combined_sig <- combined %>%
  filter(qval <= q_cut) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10 = -log10(pmax(qval, 1e-300)),
    direction = ifelse(coef > 0, "Enriched", "Depleted")
  )

p <- ggplot(combined_sig, aes(x = coef, y = neglog10)) +

  geom_point(
    aes(color = Level, shape = direction),
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(q_cut),
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ value, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Phylum" = "#1b9e77",
    "Class"  = "#d95f02",
    "Family" = "#e7298a",
    "Genus"  = "#7570b3"
  )) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),

    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 20),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Differential Abundance Across Taxonomic Levels (no SEQ13)",
    x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient (log effect size)",
    y = "-log10(q-value)",
    color = "Taxonomic level",
    shape = "Direction"
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = feature),
    size = 5.0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(base_dir, "Volcano_MultiLevel_SignificantOnly_no13.pdf"),
  p,
  width = 20,
  height = 10
)
```
